check_preference_sets_shape.name: check_preference_sets_shape
check_preference_sets_shape.value: ("discovery_preference_sets"."scope"='interest' AND "discovery_preference_sets"."interest_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("discovery_preference_sets"."scope"='exploration' AND "discovery_preference_sets"."interest_id" IS NULL)

check_preferences_ownership.name: check_preferences_ownership
check_preferences_ownership.value: ("discovery_preferences"."origin"='learned' AND "discovery_preferences"."polarity" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_preferences"."dimension" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_preferences"."user_edited_at" IS NULL) OR ("discovery_preferences"."origin"='user' AND "discovery_preferences"."polarity" IS NULL AND "discovery_preferences"."dimension" IS NULL AND "discovery_preferences"."user_edited_at" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_preferences"."status" IN ('active','deleted'))

check_preferences_deletion.name: check_preferences_deletion
check_preferences_deletion.value: ("discovery_preferences"."status"='deleted' AND "discovery_preferences"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_preferences"."deleted_feedback_sequence" IS NOT NULL) OR ("discovery_preferences"."status"<>'deleted' AND "discovery_preferences"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "discovery_preferences"."deleted_feedback_sequence" IS NULL)

check_discovery_recommendation_states_re.name: check_discovery_recommendation_states_reaction_zero
check_discovery_recommendation_states_re.value: "discovery_recommendation_states"."reaction_revision" > 0 OR ("discovery_recommendation_states"."reaction" IS NULL AND "discovery_recommendation_states"."reaction_changed_at" IS NULL AND "discovery_recommendation_states"."learned_reaction" IS NULL)

check_discovery_recommendation_states_op.name: check_discovery_recommendation_states_opened_shape
check_discovery_recommendation_states_op.value: ("discovery_recommendation_states"."first_opened_at" IS NULL AND "discovery_recommendation_states"."last_opened_at" IS NULL) OR ("discovery_recommendation_states"."first_opened_at" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_recommendation_states"."last_opened_at" IS NOT NULL AND "discovery_recommendation_states"."first_opened_at" <= "discovery_recommendation_states"."last_opened_at")

check_recommendation_candidates_inactive.name: check_recommendation_candidates_inactive_reason
check_recommendation_candidates_inactive.value: ("recommendation_candidates"."status" = 'active' AND "recommendation_candidates"."inactive_reason" IS NULL) OR ("recommendation_candidates"."status" = 'inactive' AND "recommendation_candidates"."inactive_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "recommendation_candidates"."inactive_reason" IN ('expired','unrelated','excluded','unsuitable'))

check_search_history_counts.name: check_search_history_counts
check_search_history_counts.value: ("search_history"."result_count" IS NULL OR "search_history"."result_count" >= 0) AND ("search_history"."new_item_count" IS NULL OR "search_history"."new_item_count" >= 0)
